sharedPrompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create one PREVIEW-ONLY cartoon Demon Echo vessel for the Among Demons Bag. Reference 1 is the OLD vessel, for its general silhouette and central role emblem ONLY. Reference 2 is the new approved-for-this-study flat cartoon flask: match its bold near-black outlines, chunky construction, sparse large ornaments and simple two-tone coloring VERY closely. Reference 3 is a production demon, confirming the hand-inked cartoon game language; do not put that demon's body or face on the bottle. Redesign reference 1 from scratch in reference 2's graphic language. NO photoreal scratches, corrosion, stone noise, glass glare, beveled metallic reflections, white highlight lines, tiny engravings, fine filigree, gradients or micro details. Blue-slate frame #475B70 with dark #263545 flat hard shadows, restrained flat ochre trim and ivory emblem. Each material has a base tone and at most ONE broad hard-edged shadow. Keep the type's silhouette distinctive, and the suspended emblem bold and readable at 64px. Fewer shapes, thicker strokes, not a realistic fantasy prop. Colored magical essence occupies about 65% of the open window behind the emblem, with a simple curved surface and one darker color block. No bloom, light rays, particles or sparkles. Do not add a creature, a face, letters, numbers, labels, rarity badge or decorative outer frame. One complete object centered, straight-on with only a very small top plane, square canvas. The vessel's longest dimension occupies about 82% of the canvas, but preserve its natural tall or wide shape. Uniform light blue-gray matte #C4CFD0 outside the object, no checkerboard, no floor, no cast shadow.

items.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Redraw the first image as a MUCH SIMPLER, flatter 2D cartoon inventory item matching the hand-inked demons in references 2 and 3. Uniform light blue-gray matte #C4CFD0 outside the vessel, no floor, no cast shadow, no texture. No lettering, no rarity badge, no face, no glass highlights, no more details than a cartoon monster.
